name: Plans For The Future
overview: Scripture teaches that while humans may devise many plans, it is ultimately the counsel and purpose of the LORD that prevails, as seen in Proverbs 19:21. Believers are called to trust fully in the LORD rather than their own understanding (Proverbs 3:5) and to commit their works to Him so their thoughts and plans will be established (Proverbs 16:3). God's thoughts and ways surpass ours (Isaiah 55:8), and He promises plans of peace and hope for our future (Jeremiah 29:11). Jesus reminds us not to be anxious about daily needs, emphasizing reliance on God's provision rather than worrying about what lies ahead (Matthew 6:25).
